findings.detail: Per InfluenceWatch and reporting: Selnick is a retired USAF Captain who 'formerly worked as executive director of CVA's Fixing Veterans Health Care Bipartisan Taskforce, senior advisor to the secretary of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, and veteran affairs advisor to the White House Domestic Policy Council. Selnick, a retired Air Force officer, worked as a senior adviser to the Concerned Veterans for America from 2019 to 2024.' American Oversight FOIA documents show Selnick communicating with Mar-a-Lago members in May 2017 and arranging a meeting between then-VA Sec Shulkin and Bill Frist. Selnick rejoined CVA as Senior Adviser May 2018 (per DeSmog) after his White House DPC role, indicating a CVA-government revolving door. In 2025 he became Hegseth's Deputy Chief of Staff at DoD; suspended April 16 2025 in the same leak-investigation cohort as Caldwell and Carroll. Selnick is the longest-tenured CVA-government revolver in the dossier: government -> CVA -> government -> CVA -> government.
